chapter.v:
This is
the record of Adam's descendants. When God created human beings, he made them to be like him.

He created
them male and female, and blessed them. On the day he created them he called them “human.”

When Adam
was 130, he had a son who was like him, made in his image; and he named him Seth.

Adam lived
another 800 years after Seth was born, and had other sons and daughters.

Adam lived
a total of 930 years, and then he died.

When Seth
was 105, he had Enosh.

Seth lived
another 807 years after Enosh was born, and had other sons and daughters.

Seth lived
a total of 912 years, and then he died.

When Enosh
was 90, he had Kenan.

Enosh lived
another 815 years after Kenan was born, and had other sons and daughters.

Enosh lived
a total of 905 years, and then he died.

When Kenan
was 70, he had Mehalalel.

Kenan lived
another 840 years after Mehalalel was born, and had other sons and daughters.

Kenan lived
a total of 910 years, and then he died.

When Mahalalel
was 65, he had Jared.

After Jared
was born, Mahalalel lived another 830 years and had other sons and daughters.

Mahalalel lived
a total of 895 years, and then he died.

When Jared
was 162, he had Enoch.

After Enoch
was born, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.

Jared lived
a total of 962 years, and then he died.

When Enoch
was 65, he had Methuselah.

He had
a close relationship with God. After Methuselah was born, Enoch lived another 300 years and had other sons and daughters.

Enoch lived
a total of 365 years.

Enoch had
such a close relationship with God that he didn't die, he just wasn't there anymore, because God took him.

When Methuselah
was 187, he had Lamech.

After Lamech
was born, Methuselah lived another 782 years and had other sons and daughters.

Methuselah lived
a total of 969 years, and then he died.

When Lamech
was 182, he had a son.

He named
him Noah, with the explanation, “He will provide relief for us from all the hard manual labor we need to do in cultivating the ground the Lord has cursed.”

After Noah
was born, Lamech lived another 595 years and had other sons and daughters.

Lamech lived
a total of 777 years, and then he died.

Noah was
500 before he had Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
